title: FINZANJIR 16 qatlam — ZIP REQ reyestri va kod dalillari

status_semantics.PARTIAL: Kod/test dalili mavjud, lekin kamida bitta qabul mezoni yoki tashqi shart bajarilmagan.
status_semantics.COMPLETE: Faqat barcha tasdiqlangan qabul mezonlari aniq build/muhit/sana/dalil bilan yopilganda; ushbu reyestrda hozircha ishlatilmaydi.
status_semantics.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: Qonuniy ruxsat, bank kelishuvi, real deployment yoki mustaqil baholash talab qilinadi.
status_semantics.OPEN_DECISION: Qabul mezoni, vakolatli rol yoki siyosat hali kelishilmagan.

safety_invariants: Signal firibgarlik isboti emas; risk balli aybdorlik hukmi emas; Case yakuniy hukm emas.
AI xulosasi bank yoki huquqiy qarorni almashtirmaydi.
Cross-Bank almashinuvi qonuniy va xavfsizlik ruxsatisiz o‘chiq qoladi.
Faqat sintetik test ma’lumoti; live-bank yoki production validatsiya da’vo qilinmaydi.
AI modeli/xulqini o‘zgartirish ushbu bosqich doirasidan tashqarida.

layers.label: Dalil va ma’lumot kelib chiqishi
layers.requirement: Har bir muhim yozuvda manba, vaqt, olish usuli, versiya va identifikatorni kuzatish.
remaining_gaps: External source authentication and signature verification
Production-grade encrypted/backup-backed evidence storage and operational retention policy

layers.label: Ma’lumot sifati va ishonchliligi
layers.requirement: To‘liqsizlik, eskirish, dublikat, tartibdan chiqish va zid qiymatlarni yashirmasdan belgilash.
remaining_gaps: Source-specific freshness thresholds and schema drift monitoring
Independent data-quality evaluation

layers.label: Xavf va noaniqlikni boshqarish
layers.requirement: Risk score, evidence confidence, sabablar va yetishmayotgan dalillarni ajratish; ballni aybdorlik deb ko‘rsatmaslik.
remaining_gaps: Real etalon dataset bilan kalibrlash
Counter-evidence va uncertainty modelini mustaqil baholash

layers.label: Inson nazorati va xatoni tuzatish
layers.requirement: Noaniq/yuqori ta’sirli holatlarni inson ko‘rigiga yo‘naltirish; oldingi va yangi qiymat izini saqlash.
remaining_gaps: Haqiqiy identity/RBAC va reviewer vakolati
Ikkinchi mustaqil ko‘rik va operatsion correction workflow

layers.label: Qoidalar va modellarni boshqarish
layers.requirement: Qoida/threshold versiyasi, o‘zgarish sababi, actor va old/new qiymatlarni kuzatish.
remaining_gaps: Production proposer/approver RBAC va vazifalarni ajratish
Durable/tamper-evident audit
Tasdiqlangan rollout va rollback boshqaruvi

layers.label: Ma’lumotni oshkor qilish va almashish nazorati
layers.requirement: Tashqi uzatishdan oldin maqsad, ruxsat, qabul qiluvchi va minimal maydonlarni tekshirish.
remaining_gaps: Server-side authenticated bank role va purpose authorization
DLP, huquqiy disclosure workflow va data-sharing kelishuvi

layers.label: Avtomatik jarayonlar xavfsizligi
layers.requirement: Faqat ruxsatli amal; kill-switch, circuit-breaker, timeout va noaniq holatda xavfsiz to‘xtash.
remaining_gaps: Server-side persistent kill-switch va distributed circuit-breaker
Production monitoring, rollback automation va incident integratsiyasi

layers.label: Tranzaksiya zanjiri va Case bog‘liqligi
layers.requirement: Transaction, Signal, Evidence, Risk, Threshold, Case va audit correlation identifikatorlarini bog‘lash.
remaining_gaps: Synthetic graph replay and versioned chain reconstruction
Legal authorization for bank-interbank graph

layers.label: Fuqaro shaffofligi va e’tiroz
layers.requirement: Fuqaro uchun tushunarli status va e’tiroz yo‘li; ichki/maxfiy yoki boshqa shaxs ma’lumotini oshkor qilmaslik.
remaining_gaps: Authenticated citizen identity va faqat o‘z yozuvlariga kirish
Tasdiqlangan bildirishnoma kanali/SLA va vakolatli caseworker

layers.label: Maxfiylik va ma’lumotlar hayotiy sikli
layers.requirement: Ma’lumot turi, maqsad, saqlash muddati, kirish va o‘chirish/arxivlash siyosatini boshqarish.
remaining_gaps: Durable retention/deletion job va o‘chirish dalili
At-rest/in-transit encryption, key management va hosting nazorati
Huquqiy asos, purpose limitation va data-subject rights workflow

layers.label: Xavfsizlik hodisasiga javob
layers.requirement: Hodisa tasnifi, mas’ul, eskalatsiya, dalilni saqlash, tiklash va post-incident review.
remaining_gaps: Durable incident record va tamper-evident audit
Tasdiqlangan runbook, on-call egasi va eskalatsiya kanali
Forensic retention va mustaqil incident drill

layers.label: Bilimlar bazasi va AI ishonchliligi
layers.requirement: AI javobini manbaga bog‘lash, dalil yetishmasa cheklash va tasdiqsiz authoritative bilimni o‘zgartirmaslik.
remaining_gaps: Multilingual/adversarial mustaqil baholash
Knowledge approval workflow va drift monitoring

layers.label: Sinov va mustaqil baholash
layers.requirement: Har bir talabni test, kutilgan/haqiqiy natija va qayta tiklanadigan dalil bilan bog‘lash.
remaining_gaps: Mustaqil evaluator va tashqi ekspertiza
Real labeled data bilan precision/recall va subgroup harm assessment

layers.label: Bank integratsiyasiga tayyorlik
layers.requirement: Integratsiyani faqat huquqiy/hamkorlik shartlari, API spetsifikatsiyasi, autentifikatsiya va sandbox tasdiqlanganda tayyor deb baholash.
remaining_gaps: Bank/PSP sandbox va tasdiqlangan API spec
Imzolangan MOU/data-sharing kelishuvi va legal purpose approval
Mustaqil security assessment va operational acceptance

layers.label: Samaradorlik va quvvat
layers.requirement: Javob vaqti, xato ulushi, resurs, navbat, timeout va tiklanishni muhit/yuklama bilan o‘lchash.
remaining_gaps: Tasdiqlangan deployment muhitida repeatable load/stress/soak test
Kelishilgan SLO/SLA, capacity plan va real monitoring

layers.label: Ta’sir va zarar kamayishini o‘lchash
layers.requirement: FP/FN, e’tiroz/tuzatish, kechikish va fuqaro zarari ko‘rsatkichlarini aniq denominator va metodika bilan o‘lchash.
remaining_gaps: Bank bilan kelishilgan baseline/outcome va qonuniy pilot ma’lumoti
Mustaqil impact/fairness baholash
Sababiy ta’sir va oldi olingan zarar bo‘yicha tekshirilgan natijalar

global_open_requirements.label: Release gate
evidence_refs: CI workflow and branch protection must be reviewed
remaining_gaps: Approved release-blocking policy and authorized exception role
